creator: Alexander Terp
description: Spike for MIP-10 stage 4 (docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md section 6, and MIP-4 decision 4 (b)). Measure, on macOS and on Linux: whether a muster-daemon started through Launch Services (and on Linux, by `muster msg` with no session) reaches the user's ssh agent and can open an ssh master to a configured machine; and what happens when ssh needs an interactive login (ssh runs in batch mode and refuses a password: crates/muster-ssh/src/tunnel.rs). Record the findings as an observation under docs/observations/ and on this card. Changes nothing outside a scratch setup.
title: MIP-10 stage 4 spike: can a daemon with no app open ssh links?
